_doc: Them report = them 1 muc vao 'reports'. Moi section co sql (DuckDB, bang ev) va node (khai bao tuong duong: where[{f,op,v}], groupBy, aggs{ten:{fn:count|sum|max,field}}, select, orderBy[[col,asc|desc]], limit). Cot ev: type,date,ts,v,event,session_id,agent_id,agent_type,actor(main|sub),project,cwd,tool,target,target_kind,ok,dur_ms,turns,in_tok(=tokens_in),out_tok(=tokens_out),status,model,summary. Doc ca v1 (agent{id,type}, data.input_tokens) lan v2 (phang).

reports.name: summary
reports.description: Dem theo type, tool, agent, phien

sections.title: by_type
sections.sql: SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM ev GROUP BY type ORDER BY n DESC, type

sections.title: by_tool
sections.sql: SELECT tool, count(*) AS n FROM ev WHERE tool IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tool ORDER BY n DESC, tool

sections.title: by_agent
sections.sql: SELECT actor, agent_type, count(*) AS n FROM ev GROUP BY actor, agent_type ORDER BY n DESC, actor, agent_type

sections.title: by_session
sections.sql: SELECT session_id, count(*) AS n FROM ev GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY n DESC, session_id

sections.title: slow
sections.sql: SELECT ts, session_id, tool, target, dur_ms FROM ev WHERE dur_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dur_ms DESC, ts, session_id LIMIT 10

sections.title: errors
sections.sql: SELECT ts, session_id, actor, tool, target FROM ev WHERE ok = false ORDER BY ts, session_id

reports.name: writes
reports.description: File bi ghi/sua: phien chinh (agent==null) vs subagent

sections.title: by_actor
sections.sql: SELECT actor, count(*) AS n FROM ev WHERE tool IN ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit') GROUP BY actor ORDER BY actor

sections.title: by_file
sections.sql: SELECT actor, target, count(*) AS n FROM ev WHERE tool IN ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit') GROUP BY actor, target ORDER BY n DESC, actor, target

sections.title: timeline
sections.sql: SELECT ts, event, actor, tool, target, ok, dur_ms FROM ev ORDER BY ts, event, tool, target

sections.title: hot-files
sections.sql: SELECT target, count(*) AS n FROM ev WHERE target IS NOT NULL AND tool IN ('Read','Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit') GROUP BY target ORDER BY n DESC, target LIMIT 20

reports.name: tokens
reports.description: Token theo phien x agent. v2 tokens_in/out tren Stop/SubagentStop la LUY KE trong phien nen lay max (khong cong don); v1: data.input_tokens/output_tokens

sections.title: tokens
sections.sql: SELECT session_id, actor, agent_id, max(in_tok) AS in_tok, max(out_tok) AS out_tok FROM ev WHERE in_tok IS NOT NULL OR out_tok IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session_id, actor, agent_id ORDER BY session_id, actor, agent_id

sections.title: subagents
sections.sql: SELECT agent_type, agent_id, count(*) AS n, sum(dur_ms) AS dur_ms FROM ev WHERE agent_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agent_type, agent_id ORDER BY n DESC, agent_id

reports.name: events
reports.description: Su kien tho (mac dinh khi khong co --report)

sections.title: events
sections.sql: SELECT ts, type, event, session_id, actor, tool, target, ok, dur_ms FROM ev ORDER BY ts, session_id, event, tool, target

reports.name: checkpoint
reports.description: Tom tat checkpoint phien gan nhat: prompt, edits, loi/unresolved, stop

sections.title: last_prompt
sections.sql: SELECT ts, session_id, actor, summary FROM ev WHERE event = 'UserPromptSubmit' OR type = 'prompt' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

sections.title: edits_and_commits
sections.sql: SELECT ts, session_id, actor, tool, target, ok FROM ev WHERE tool IN ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 5

sections.title: errors_and_unresolved
sections.sql: SELECT ts, session_id, actor, tool, target, ok, status FROM ev WHERE ok = false OR status = 'started' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 5

sections.title: stop_summary
sections.sql: SELECT ts, session_id, actor, status, turns, in_tok, out_tok, summary FROM ev WHERE event IN ('Stop','SubagentStop') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
